title: Replay ordinary keyless child creation after its own parent revision change
outcome: Replay ordinary keyless child creation after its own parent revision change
acceptance: Stable-session CLI and MCP lost-response retries of an identical child add with initial notes recover the original child and observations for both unclaimed and holder-owned parents after decomposition advances the parent; distinct new intents still create distinct children.
